I replied to Tobias in a thread under his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot is **Southgate**.

- **Where it comes from:** Priyanka's posts in that channel on 2025-09-03. She wrote that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 she said Southgate had cleared the backlog and closed the incident. Tobias is a member of that channel, so he can read all of this himself.
- **What's missing:** I couldn't find a street address or any other detail about the Southgate site. There's no Tansley account folder in the files he can see, and GBrain only has the same incident chat. I said this in the reply and suggested he ask Priyanka.

GBrain's search ran on keywords only this time, so it could have missed notes that word things differently.
